name: Rod Benedikt Widdensov
source:
"I want the people I love to be happy. I don't care if their happiness causes me pain. I'd rather bear that alone instead of bringing down those around me."

Prince of Angielle and stepbrother to Lucette through his mother's marriage to the King. Rod is quiet, opinionated, and fiercely protective of those he loves.

Is mute, and uses his plush bunny to 'speak'. Though he cannot actually talk, this does not stop him from voicing his opinions.
